subject: [PATCH v3 3/7] sched/numa: scan read-only file mappings in tiering mode

2026-09-22.patch_summary: This patch modifies the NUMA balancing code to scan read-only file mappings when tiering is enabled, but only for promotion purposes. It keeps the existing restriction on excluding shared libraries from migration. The change allows hot files to be promoted to faster memory tiers, improving performance in certain workloads.
